evidenceContract: the frozen M2C reward-modulated local eligibility EMA is read without modification
rule identifiers, target labels, logits, and action readout weights are absent from evidence ranking
task accuracy is used only by the offline evaluator after every candidate has been chosen
counterfactualContract: the live stream never rewires; every swap occurs in an isolated controller clone
all 17 legal inactive sources replace the same weakest slot and inherit the same weight
no-swap and every candidate share forward horizon, trial symbols, exploration draws, and evaluation probes
statistics aggregate checkpoints within each carrier-parameter and seed run before confidence intervals
conclusions: 独立确认包含 48 个种子-载体运行、864 个检查点和 14688 个候选换边反事实。
局部证据与反事实收益的平均 Spearman 相关为 0.046 [0.029, 0.062]；相对打乱排名的优势为 0.044 [0.027, 0.060]。
证据首选换边平均收益为 +0.1 pp，随机候选期望为 -0.1 pp，差为 +0.2 pp [+0.1, +0.3]。
反事实 oracle 平均收益为 +1.4 pp；证据首选的平均遗憾为 1.3 pp，top-quartile 命中率为 29.7%。
相关最强的是阶段 5（A）：Spearman 0.155，首选收益 +1.0 pp，oracle 收益 +2.5 pp；该阶段不能替代总体确认结论。
离线结构证据诊断决策为 CounterfactualEffectsFlat。
在冻结的一边替换自由度和短期窗口内，连 oracle 换边也缺少收益；瓶颈在结构自由度或评价时间尺度。
